title: Everglades Adventure and Miami City Tour
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Experience the Everglades Adventure and Miami City Tour in one unforgettable journey that combines an exciting Everglades Adventure with a comprehensive Miami City Tour. Unlike standard sightseeing tours, this experience lets you explore Miami’s vibrant neighborhoods and the unique natural beauty of the Everglades in a single day. From spotting wildlife on an airboat ride to discovering iconic destinations like South Beach, Wynwood, Bayside Marketplace, and Little Havana, you'll enjoy a perfect mix of nature, culture, history, and sightseeing.

Your friendly guides provide engaging commentary, local insights, and a seamless travel experience, making it easy to see Miami’s top attractions without the stress of planning. Whether you're visiting for the first time or looking to experience the city from a new perspective, this Everglades Adventure and Miami City Tour offers an exciting and memorable way to discover the very best of Miami.
